itineraries.title: Feet in the Sand, Head in the Clouds - 4-Day Itinerary
editorial: We spent one day in San Jose and three in Monteverde.
What if we had more time?

From what we heard from fellow travellers, we regret not visiting Arenal volcano near Monteverde. And if time weren’t a constraint, we’d add Playa Manuel Antonio to the itinerary for the gorgeous beach.

days.title: DAY 1 - SAN JOSE
editorial: San Jose should strictly be your port of arrival.

Unfortunately, our impression of the city was less than flattering. Prostitution is rampant, which is not a problem in and of itself, if it weren’t for the unsavoury elements propping up the business.
We toured the National Theatre during the day, and cooped up in our Airbnb after sundown.

days.title: DAY 2 - MONTEVERDE
editorial: We took the bus from San Jose to Monteverde (about 5 hours away) and immediately felt better about our trip!

Monteverde had a wonderful welcoming vibe exemplified by our hostel, Monteverde Backpackers. Filled with travellers from across the world (mainly Europe), it had the communal feeling you want from a hostel.

After dark, we did a night tour of the forest. In a couple of hours, we saw a sloth, a scorpion, a tarantula, a viper, and toucans of various hues. Our guide’s fascinating personality elevated the experience.

days.title: DAY 3 - MONTEVERDE
editorial: On dia dos in Monteverde, we explored the cloud forests by day with our newfound hostel friends.
The lushness of the forests will put you at ease as only nature can. After feasting our eyes on the green of the forest, we added a dash of colour by visiting a bird park that housed exotic species.

In the afternoon, we learnt why it’s called a “cloud” forest. The mist descending on the hills is a spectacle. One that must experienced for a camera cannot capture the dreamlike atmosphere the clouds create.
The evening was spent back in the hostel, with conversations over cooking.
One of us was also preparing themselves for the next day…

days.title: DAY 4 - MONTEVERDE
editorial: The highlight of Monteverde is zip-lining over the valleys.
If you’re scared of heights, it will be the most terrifying day of your life.
But somehow, we did it. And boy was it worth it!
As a famous ad punchline back in India goes, “Darr ke aage jeet hai”. “Beyond fear lies victory”.
